functions.residue: RESIDUE SHAPE 5 0xe8 str r0, [sp, #4] | bic r0, r0, #0xf0000000
functions.notes: Only diff: target stores the field 4d word then does one bic 0xfe000000 for the top 7 bits; mine emits bic f0000000 then bic e000000 (4e:3/4f:4) or, with a single 7-bit field, merges the bic without the intermediate str. Tried 7-bit field, signed, pointer access, chained assign, char base, order changes, colorsweep: no change.
